bullets.text: Bipartisan Bill Approved - Streamlining FCC satellite licensing aims to enhance broadband access in rural areas.
Ericsson's Maritime 5G Trial - Successful demonstration of 5G SA connectivity aboard naval vessels with Leonardo and the Italian Navy.
Boldyn's 5G Upgrade at Silverstone - New high-capacity 5G network enhances connectivity for fans and teams year-round.
Taara's Optical Switching - Aiming for carrier-grade uptime with innovative wireless optical communication technology.
Odido Data Breach - Hackers accessed personal data of 6.2 million customers, prompting security alerts.
Trusted Tech Alliance Formed - Major tech firms unite to promote transparency and security in the industry.
AI in Intent-Based Networking - Revolutionising network management with natural language processing for easier configurations.
Private 5G Networks Challenge - Space and power constraints hinder deployment in industrial environments.
Amazon Leo Satellite Approval - FCC greenlights launch of 4,500 additional satellites for Amazon's LEO constellation.
6G's Sensing Infrastructure - Future networks may integrate sensing capabilities directly into communication systems.
